memo.regime_insight: The system performs best when BIAS conviction is strong and signals align with the dominant trend; in choppy, low-conviction regimes like the current one, both directions bleed, and the monitor agent’s premature cuts magnify losses by preventing trades from reaching their designed TP.
memo.signal_trust: composite_LONG_T6 and composite_SHORT_T6 signals (AERO and MORPHO TP hits in recent trades, both +8%+ price moves); BIAS-aligned signals (WR=60% in 5 trades, confirming the directional filter works); AIXBT SHORT when BIAS=SHORT and high conviction (current regime highlights TCI_roll6 SHORT conf 85, with small but consistent wins in past AIXBT SHORT trades).
memo.blind_spots: The monitor agent is systematically cutting trades too early, converting potential TP hits into small losses or breakevens, while the TP/SL and timeout rules designed to let trades mature are being overridden.
memo.adjustment: Set BIAS to NEUTRAL (as regime card suggests) but only fire the highest-confidence signals (composite T6, AIXBT SHORT if TCI_roll6 remains active); disable the monitor agent’s early cuts, allow full T6/T12/T24 timeouts to run, and quarter-size all positions to preserve capital.
